{{Quote|How dare you? Invading my home, disrupting my business... these ungrateful wretches belong to me! I'll have your head for leading them astray.|Vobbara Yusinduu to the Alliance Commander|<ref name="LotS">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''</ref>}}
'''Vobbara Yusinduu''', also known as '''Yusinduu the Hutt''',<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Yusinduu the Hutt}}</ref> was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the era of the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="ThePathBelow" />

==Biography==
During the third Galactic War between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]], Vobbara Yusinduu settled in the [[Minboosa District]] on Nal Hutta and distinguished himself from other [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] members. Yusinduu focused his efforts on developing and managing a highly profitable [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] [[Refinery/Legends|refinery]] in the Minboosa District.<ref name="Codex" />

At some point, the [[Hidden Chain]], an organization created by [[Heta Kol]], [[Raid on the Minboosa District|raided]] the Minboosa District to take captives. As a result, Yusinduu ordered a lockdown to the whole district that prevented anyone from fleeing the district. The raiders fought against Yusinduu's [[Refinery Security Forces|security forces]] when Yusinduu ordered a lockdown.<ref name="ThePathBelow" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vobbara Yusinduu first appeared in the [[2024]] Game Update 7.5 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TORweb">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20240502-0|text=Game Update 7.5 "Desperate Defiance" Recap and VOD}}</ref>
